_comment: The ladder's own words, for the people who bring this set. Vocabulary
merges them into its "Our language" list (BestPractice spec/LADDER_OPT_IN_PLAN.md D12);
a word here replaces the universal meaning of the same word for them.

words.meaning: The branch your saved work lands on when you say "Booked" (or "Go update"): staging if you are on the ladder, otherwise main. Until 2026-10-09 the ladder landed work on pre-staging.

The two branches work climbs through, in that order. Staging is where saved work lands and waits until you say Produce, and main is production -- what everyone gets. A third branch below staging, pre-staging, was retired from the ladder on 2026-10-09: each repository's next Update Vendors moves what is left on it into staging and gives you a link to delete it.

One of these branches: staging or main (and pre-staging where it is still in use), plus the two that travel with them -- staging's old name `precedent-beta-v01` and Promote's lock branch `precedent-promote-lock`. A tier branch is never offered for deletion, except a retired pre-staging that holds nothing staging lacks.

One of the five steps work climbs from idea to production: Consider, Act, Booked, Run tests (also called Debut; optional), Produce. "Promote 3" means stage 3, and each stage is read back before it runs.
